_doc: Biochemical reactions, compiled into a Tellurium/Antimony model at runtime by core/biochemistry.py. Vmax params are filled from the user's personal enzyme_levels (Pillar 3). Active interactions modify these Vmax values before the run.

starch_digestion.note: salivary amylase is inactivated at low gastric pH; rate falls as pH drops

protein_digestion.note: pepsin only active at low pH — couple rate to state.pH

ethanol_oxidation.note: acetaldehyde is the irritant; if ALDH is suppressed it accumulates
